introduction: aflib (github.com/agent-fox-dev/aflib) is the single Go module holding packages shared by the agent-fox programs. This spec imports the forge client `issuex` from agent-fox and the durable SQLite job queue `jobqueue` from hub unchanged. It also gives the repository the standard agent-fox shape: the Makefile quality gate, lint configuration, reference docs, an exported-API golden guard and a dependency guard.

glossary.allowlist: The modules the code may depend on. Non-test code of public packages: the standard library, `github.com/google/uuid`, and this module's packages. Test files and `internal/` files may also use `modernc.org/sqlite`, plus any module ruled in under 01-REQ-4.
glossary.clean checkout: A fresh clone of this repository alone: no sibling repositories, no `go.work`, no `replace` directive.
glossary.erratum: The file `docs/errata/01_import_issuex_and_jobqueue.md`. It records the source commits, the meaning of the foreign requirement IDs in the copied tests, and every finding.
glossary.finding: A case where copied code does not work unchanged in this module. Each one is handled by the fixed rules of 01-REQ-4 and listed in the erratum.
glossary.golden: The committed file `testdata/api/<name>.golden`. It holds the comment-free, go/format-rendered exported declarations of one public package.
glossary.golden name: A package's directory relative to the module root, with `/` replaced by `_`. The root package's golden name is `aflib`.
glossary.public package: A directory of this module that contains non-test Go files for the host build context. It is not `testdata`, does not start with `.` or `_`, is not `docs` or `examples`, and has no `internal` path element.
glossary.source commit: The fixed commit a package is copied from: agent-fox `84fb9b4` for `issuex/`, hub `ce8e1b8` for `internal/jobqueue/`. Each is resolved to its full hash and read from git objects, never from a working tree.

requirements.title: Module definition
requirements.rationale: Consumers can switch to aflib by changing an import path only if the module builds by itself and pulls in nothing from its former homes.

criteria.action: declare `module github.com/agent-fox-dev/aflib` and `go 1.27`, and directly require `github.com/google/uuid` and `modernc.org/sqlite` at the versions hub's go.mod requires at its source commit. It contains no `replace` directive. `go.sum` is committed and no `go.work` is committed
contain exactly three non-internal packages: the root package `aflib`, `issuex/` and `jobqueue/`. There is no `cmd/` directory, and no `internal/` package except helpers copied under 01-REQ-4.3

consist of `doc.go` holding only a package doc comment, with no declarations and no imports. The comment names the module, says it holds the packages shared by the agent-fox programs, and gives `issuex` and `jobqueue` one line each
criteria.contract: the root package's golden is empty

criteria.condition: `go build ./...` and `go test -short ./...` run in a clean checkout
criteria.action: build and pass every test, with no network access beyond fetching the required modules and their requirements through the Go module proxy
criteria.contract: both commands exit 0

criteria.condition: `go list -m all` runs in the module
criteria.action: list only `github.com/agent-fox-dev/aflib`, `github.com/google/uuid`, `modernc.org/sqlite` and their transitive requirements
criteria.contract: no listed module path starts with `github.com/agent-fox-dev/hub`, `github.com/agent-fox-dev/agent-fox` or the AgentKit module path

criteria.condition: no forge token, forge URL variable or GitLab smoke-test variable is set in the environment and no sibling repository is present
criteria.action: still pass `go test -short ./...`, skipping only the tests the source repositories already skip in that environment
criteria.contract: exit 0; the GitLab smoke test is reported as skipped

requirements.title: Importing issuex
requirements.rationale: A byte-identical copy from a fixed commit makes the move reviewable and lets agent-fox and hub switch by changing an import path only.

criteria.action: place every file of `issuex/` from https://github.com/agent-fox-dev/agent-fox at the full hash of commit `84fb9b4` at the same relative path under `issuex/`, including `testdata/` and non-Go files. The files are extracted from git objects at that commit, for example with `git archive`
keep every non-test `.go` file under `issuex/` byte-identical to its source file, except edits listed in the erratum under 01-REQ-4.6
criteria.contract: comparing each non-test file with `git show <fullhash>:issuex/<file>` finds no difference outside the listed findings

criteria.action: limit the edits to `_test.go` files to rewriting import paths `github.com/agent-fox-dev/agent-fox/issuex` (and its sub-paths) to `github.com/agent-fox-dev/aflib/issuex`. The package names `issuex` and `issuex_test` stay unchanged
criteria.contract: a line diff of each test file against its source shows only import-path lines

criteria.action: arrive in its own commit that contains only the package's files, the test import edits and the go.mod/go.sum changes they need. The commit message names the source repository and the full commit hash

criteria.condition: the agent-fox source commit cannot be fetched
criteria.action: stop the import without reconstructing the package from memory, documentation or a different commit
criteria.contract: no `issuex/` files are committed; the handoff reports the unreachable commit

criteria.condition: `go test -short ./issuex/...` runs in a clean checkout
criteria.action: pass every copied test. This covers environment-driven forge detection, the `git remote get-url` fallback, the `gh` probe, and the precedence of explicit `Options` over the environment. The GitLab smoke test is skipped unless its environment variable is set, as in the source
criteria.contract: exit 0

requirements.title: Importing jobqueue
requirements.rationale: The agent-fox service and hub both need the same durable job queue, and hub's `internal/` copy cannot be imported from outside hub.

criteria.action: place every file of `internal/jobqueue/` from https://github.com/agent-fox-dev/hub at the full hash of commit `ce8e1b8` at the same relative path under `jobqueue/`. The files are extracted from git objects at that commit
keep every non-test `.go` file under `jobqueue/` byte-identical to its source file, except edits listed in the erratum under 01-REQ-4.6
criteria.contract: comparing each non-test file with `git show <fullhash>:internal/jobqueue/<file>` finds no difference outside the listed findings

criteria.action: limit the edits to `_test.go` files to rewriting `github.com/agent-fox-dev/hub/internal/jobqueue` to `github.com/agent-fox-dev/aflib/jobqueue`
criteria.contract: a line diff of each test file against its source shows only import-path lines

criteria.action: arrive in its own commit that contains only the package's files, the test import edits and the go.mod/go.sum changes they need. The commit message names the source repository and the full commit hash

criteria.condition: the hub source commit cannot be fetched
criteria.action: stop the import without reconstructing the package from memory, documentation or a different commit
criteria.contract: no `jobqueue/` files are committed; the handoff reports the unreachable commit

criteria.action: import `modernc.org/sqlite` only from `_test.go` files, and import only the standard library and `github.com/google/uuid` from non-test files

criteria.condition: `go test -short ./jobqueue/...` runs in a clean checkout
criteria.action: pass every copied test against SQLite opened through `modernc.org/sqlite`
criteria.contract: exit 0

requirements.title: Handling findings during the import
requirements.rationale: An unattended run needs a deterministic answer for code that does not work unchanged in its new home, and must never trade a test away for a passing build.

criteria.action: keep every copied test: none is deleted, skipped, gated with `t.Skip`, or weakened to make the build pass
criteria.contract: the set of `Test*`, `Fuzz*` and `Example*` function names in each package equals the set at the source commit

criteria.condition: a copied non-test file imports another package of its source module
criteria.action: stop without copying that package and without editing the file
criteria.contract: the finding is recorded in the erratum and reported in the handoff as blocking

criteria.condition: a copied test file imports a test helper package of its source module
criteria.action: copy the helper files the tests need into `internal/<helper>/` of this module, so the test files' edits stay import-path-only, and record the copy in `docs/architecture.md`
criteria.contract: the test file diff shows only import-path lines; the helper appears in the erratum

criteria.condition: a copied test needs a module outside the allowlist
criteria.action: add that module as a test-only dependency, record a ruling naming it in `docs/architecture.md`, and add it to the test allowlist of 01-REQ-6
criteria.contract: the module appears in go.mod and in the erratum, and only `_test.go` or `internal/` files import it

criteria.condition: `golangci-lint` reports a finding in copied code
criteria.action: add a path-scoped exclusion to `.golangci.yml`, with a comment pointing at the erratum, and leave the copied code unedited
criteria.contract: `golangci-lint run` exits 0; the exclusion is listed in the erratum

criteria.condition: `gofmt` or `go vet` rejects copied code
criteria.action: make the smallest edit that passes, without changing any exported declaration
criteria.contract: the edit is listed in the erratum with file and reason; the package's golden still equals its source exported declarations

criteria.condition: a copied test fails in the new location for an environmental reason, such as missing testdata
criteria.action: fix the cause outside the test file. Where no such fix exists, stop
criteria.contract: the fix, or the blocking failure, is recorded in the erratum and the handoff

requirements.title: Exported-API golden
requirements.rationale: A change to any exported declaration, or a new public package, must fail the quality gate until a person accepts it on purpose.

criteria.condition: `TestExportedAPI` in package `aflib_test` at the module root runs
criteria.action: discover every public package under the module root. A directory counts when it holds non-test Go files for the host build context (selected with `go/build`). It is skipped when it is `testdata`, starts with `.` or `_`, is `docs` or `examples`, or has an `internal` path element
criteria.contract: on the committed tree the discovered set is exactly {aflib, issuex, jobqueue}

criteria.action: render each public package's exported declarations using only `go/build`, `go/parser`, `go/doc` and `go/format`, without executing `go doc`. The order is constants, variables, functions, then types, each type followed by its constants, variables, functions and methods in `go/doc` order. Each declaration is formatted by `go/format`, followed by a blank line, with doc, field and line comments removed, and with no package clause or import path
compare each package's rendering with `testdata/api/<golden name>.golden`. A package with no exported declarations has an empty golden
criteria.contract: `testdata/api/aflib.golden` is empty; `issuex.golden` and `jobqueue.golden` equal the source packages' exported declarations at their source commits

criteria.condition: a package's rendering differs from its golden
criteria.action: fail the test
criteria.contract: the failure message names the package, the first differing line, and the command that regenerates the goldens (`make api-golden`)

criteria.condition: a discovered public package has no golden file
criteria.action: fail the test
criteria.contract: the failure message names the package

criteria.condition: a golden file in `testdata/api/` matches no discovered package
criteria.action: fail the test
criteria.contract: the failure message names the golden file

criteria.condition: the test runs with `-update`, or `make api-golden` runs
criteria.action: rewrite the golden of every discovered public package with its current rendering
criteria.contract: a following run without `-update` passes

criteria.action: for any package source, give byte-identical output across repeated renders and across edits that change only comments or unexported identifiers

requirements.title: Dependency guard
requirements.rationale: The allowlist rule and the no-replace rule need a check inside `make check` to be enforceable.

criteria.condition: go.mod contains a `replace` directive, in single-line or block form
criteria.action: fail the test
criteria.contract: the failure message names `go.mod` and the replace directive

criteria.condition: go.mod directly requires, without a `// indirect` comment, a module outside {`github.com/google/uuid`, `modernc.org/sqlite`} plus modules added under 01-REQ-4.4
criteria.action: fail the test
criteria.contract: the failure message names `go.mod` and the offending module path

criteria.condition: a non-test file of a public package imports a path that is not standard library, `github.com/google/uuid`, or a package of this module
criteria.action: fail the test
criteria.contract: the failure message names the file and the offending import path

criteria.condition: a test file, or any file of an `internal/` package, imports a path that is not standard library, a package of this module, or the test allowlist {`github.com/google/uuid`, `modernc.org/sqlite`} plus modules added under 01-REQ-4.4
criteria.action: fail the test
criteria.contract: the failure message names the file and the offending import path

criteria.action: for any import path, classify it as standard library exactly when the first `/`-separated element of the path contains no dot

parse go.mod `require` blocks, single-line `require` directives, `// indirect` comments and `replace` directives with standard-library code only. It makes no network access and imports no third-party module

criteria.condition: `TestDependencies` runs against the committed tree
criteria.action: pass
criteria.contract: test result PASS with no reported violations

requirements.title: Makefile and lint configuration
requirements.rationale: Every agent-fox repository runs the same quality gate, and `make check` is the only gate agents run.

criteria.action: provide these targets. `help`. `build` (`go build ./...`). `test` (`go test ./... -count=1`). `test-short` (`go test -short ./...`). `coverage`. `fmt` (gofmt in place over all tracked Go files). `vet` (`go vet ./...`). `lint`. `check`. `check-release` (fmt, vet, lint, test). `doc`. `tidy` (`go mod tidy`). `clean`. `api-golden`. There is no nested-module loop

criteria.condition: `make check` runs
criteria.action: run `fmt`, `vet`, `lint` and `test-short` in that order, stopping at the first failing step
criteria.contract: exit 0 when all four steps pass; a non-zero exit, with no later step run, when one fails

criteria.condition: `golangci-lint` is not on PATH when `make lint` runs
criteria.action: print a message that linting was skipped and succeed
criteria.contract: exit 0 with a skip message on stdout

criteria.condition: `make doc` runs
criteria.action: write `go doc -all <importpath>` for each public package to `docs/generated/<golden name>.txt`
criteria.contract: on the committed tree it produces exactly `aflib.txt`, `issuex.txt` and `jobqueue.txt`, and `git status --porcelain docs/generated` is empty afterwards

criteria.action: equal hub's `.golangci.yml` at its source commit, minus every rule that names a hub path, plus only the path-scoped `issuex` exclusions added under 01-REQ-4.5, each with a comment pointing at the erratum

criteria.condition: `golangci-lint run` runs over a clean checkout with `.golangci.yml`
criteria.action: report no findings
criteria.contract: exit 0

requirements.title: Reference docs and erratum
requirements.rationale: Agents and consumers find their way through the reference docs, and the erratum explains everything that differs from a plain copy.

criteria.action: state that the repository has no REST API, map the public packages `aflib`, `issuex` and `jobqueue` with each one's purpose and principal exported identifiers taken from the copied code, and point to `docs/generated/`

cover each package's origin (repository and full hash), the import graph (neither package imports the other; `issuex` is standard library only; `jobqueue` uses the standard library and uuid; tests also use `modernc.org/sqlite`), the allowlist and the rule that a new module needs a ruling there first, the test layout, `jobqueue`'s caller contract (caller-owned `*sql.DB` with WAL and `busy_timeout`, idempotent handlers), versioning (`vX.Y.Z` tags, first `v0.1.0` cut by a human after both consumers switch; before 1.0 a breaking change bumps the minor version and is recorded in the errata), and any `internal/` helpers added under 01-REQ-4.3

state in `docs/cli.md`, in one line, that the repository has no command. List in `docs/configuration.md` every environment variable the copied `issuex` code reads (checked against the code, not only `GITHUB_TOKEN`, `GITLAB_TOKEN`, `GITLAB_API_URL` and `GITHUB_API_URL`), its precedence below explicit `Options`, the `git` and `gh` fallbacks, and the fact that hub sets everything explicitly. It also states that `jobqueue` reads no environment

exist at `docs/errata/01_import_issuex_and_jobqueue.md`. It records the source repository and full hash of each package. It explains that requirement IDs in copied test names and comments (such as `10-REQ-6.E3` and `01-REQ-4.8`) refer to the source repositories' spec archives, not to this repository's specs. It lists every finding, or states that there were none

explain the module and its two packages, how to require it (`go get github.com/agent-fox-dev/aflib`), the quality commands (`make check`, `make doc`, `make api-golden`), and link to the docs under `docs/`

requirements.title: Agent policy files
requirements.rationale: Agents read AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and the steering first, and these files still describe AgentKit.

criteria.action: rewrite only its Repository Layout section to describe this repository: `doc.go` (root package, doc only), `issuex/`, `jobqueue/`, the root guard tests and `testdata/api/`, `docs/` and `docs/generated/`, `.specs/`, and tests living next to the code. Every other section stays byte-identical
have content byte-identical to AGENTS.md after the rewrite

rewrite only its Repository Specifics section. It states that aflib is a library with no REST API and no command, that `docs/api.md` is the map of its public packages, and that it is a single module with no nested modules. Every other section stays byte-identical

execution_paths.title: A developer runs the quality gate in a clean checkout

steps.action: clones aflib alone, with no go.work and no sibling repositories, and runs `make check`
runs gofmt and `go vet ./...`, then golangci-lint (or prints that it was skipped)
fetches uuid and modernc.org/sqlite through the module proxy and runs `go test -short ./...`
exercise issuex against httptest servers and jobqueue against SQLite, and skip the GitLab smoke test
TestExportedAPI matches the three goldens and TestDependencies finds no violation

execution_paths.title: A developer changes an exported declaration and accepts it on purpose

steps.action: changes the signature of an exported declaration in a public package and runs `make check`
renders the package, finds it differs from its golden, and fails, naming the package, the first differing line and `make api-golden`
reruns `make check`, which exits 0 with the updated golden in the working tree

execution_paths.title: A developer adds a disallowed dependency

steps.action: adds a `replace` directive or a non-allowlisted import to a public package and runs `make check`
parses go.mod and each package's imports with the standard library
fails, naming the file and the offending directive or import

execution_paths.title: A developer regenerates the generated docs

steps.action: discovers the public packages and runs `go doc -all` for each one
writes `docs/generated/aflib.txt`, `issuex.txt` and `jobqueue.txt`, which match the committed files
